notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding {W} for each enchantment you control.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Serra's Sanctum and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.
